en.title: One Piece Season 3 Adds Alabasta Heroes: Meet the New Cast
en.summary: The live-action One Piece saga continues its journey to the desert kingdom of Alabasta with significant cast additions. Netflix has officially revealed the actors stepping into the boots of key figures from this pivotal arc.
en.body:
Netflix's ambitious live-action adaptation of **Eiichiro Oda's** legendary manga, **One Piece**, is gearing up for its next major chapter, and the winds of the Grand Line are bringing new faces to the Straw Hat Pirates' adventure. Fresh off the immense success of its debut season, the series is expanding its ensemble as it sets course for the sandy dunes of Alabasta. Four new actors have been confirmed to join the cast, ready to bring to life pivotal characters instrumental in the upcoming arc.

The newly announced cast members will portray figures crucial to the conflict and resolution within the Alabasta saga. Taking on the role of **Koza**, the courageous leader of the Alabasta rebellion, is **Ethan McGreggor**. **Joaquim de Almeida** will embody **Toto**, the respected elder and father of Koza, known for his unwavering spirit. The formidable **Pell**, the loyal guardian and captain of the Alabasta Royal Guard with the power of a mythical bird, will be played by **Tantoo Cardinal**. Rounding out the additions is **Chaka**, another key member of the Royal Guard, brought to the screen by **David Chen**. These additions are vital as the Straw Hats will soon find themselves entangled in the political intrigue and civil war plaguing the desert kingdom, facing off against the formidable Baroque Works and its enigmatic leader, Crocodile.

## Alabasta's Arrival: Stakes Are Higher Than Ever

The journey to Alabasta is one of the most significant arcs in the **One Piece** narrative, introducing complex political themes, morally gray characters, and high-stakes battles that test the Straw Hats' resolve. For fans who have followed the manga and anime for years, seeing these characters brought to life is a moment of immense anticipation. Koza, Toto, Pell, and Chaka are not just supporting players; they are the heart of Alabasta's struggle for freedom and survival. Their presence in the live-action series confirms that the adaptation is committed to honoring the depth and emotional weight of the source material, promising a faithful yet fresh rendition of this beloved story.

## What This Means for the Straw Hats

With these new characters joining the fray, the narrative complexity of the live-action **One Piece** is set to deepen considerably. The Alabasta arc is a turning point, forcing Monkey D. Luffy and his crew to confront not just powerful adversaries but also the consequences of tyranny and rebellion. The introduction of Pell and Chaka, in particular, highlights the bravery and loyalty within the Alabasta kingdom, providing crucial allies and formidable opponents. The casting choices seem to align with the spirit of these characters, and fans are already buzzing with excitement about how these actors will embody their roles and contribute to the unfolding epic.

## What's Next

Filming for the next season is reportedly underway, with production aiming to capture the vast landscapes and intense action of Alabasta. While an official release date for **One Piece** Season 2 has not yet been announced, these casting updates suggest that production is progressing steadily, building anticipation for the Straw Hats' return to screens.

content_raw: Netflix's live-action One Piece adaptation just added four more names to its Season 3 cast. Meet the actors playing Koza, Toto, Pell, and Chaka.
